title: Cupper stuff by Dumkr-
description:
Adds new copper recipes and tools.
Tools and armor have interesting bonuses, and a new weapon has been added - the Lightning Staff!
body:
# **Meet the new copper tools and armor!**
Now copper is not only an item of decoration, but also a material for useful things. New tools and armor are crafted in the same way as regular tools from other materials.
## New weapon - **Lightning Staff!**
When hitting mobs with the staff, it summons lightning, striking mobs with the power of lightning!
### **Copper tools and armor**
Copper tools are much faster than others but not very durable. With a full set of copper armor you can move much faster!
